title: Phase7b arm M target 2 (5HT): experience store available, reuse what fits
text:
Goal: build the most reliable binding-activity predictor for 5HT and produce a top-100 ranking of the 100k library.

Constraints:
- labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/5-hydroxytryptamine_/ki/dataset_p7b.csv (read-only). Molecules reserved for the locked test set have already been removed from this file, so everything you see is yours to train on.
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi
- FROZEN SPLIT: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/5-hydroxytryptamine_/ki/splits/frozen_5-hydroxytryptamine_.json
  Pass this exact path as `--split-manifest` to ml.train. Do NOT call data.split, and do not pick your own fractions: every arm is scored on this one manifest so the numbers are comparable.
- experience store: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/experience/experience_m.json (pass this absolute path as the `store` argument of experience.retrieve; a wrong or missing path silently returns zero records)
- locked evaluation (REQUIRED): when you have a final model, call evaluation.locked exactly once with --target 5HT --endpoint Ki --desc-set <the descriptor set you trained on> and --receipt evaluation/5ht_locked.json. The receipt holds the AUROC that counts; report it verbatim.
- this is target #2 in a sequence of 9.

Before choosing your modelling approach, retrieve prior experience from that store and reuse any configuration that fits this dataset's characteristics (sample size, positive rate, target class). Only explore new configurations if prior experience does not cover this data profile.

You may choose representation, model family, and fusion.

Deliverable: report with
  (a) choices and rationale,
  (b) frozen-split validation AUROC/AUPRC/EF@1%,
  (c) the locked-test AUROC from evaluation/5ht_locked.json (quote it),
  (d) top-100 path,
  (e) cost (wall clock, jobs),
  (f) which experience_id(s) you used, and what you reused verbatim versus adapted.
